999008199.text:
――マナの恵みをもたらす白きほうき星が
やって来なくなったわけについて、私たちは調べたわ

localizations.en: We looked into why the White Comet—the source of mana's blessings—had stopped coming.

999008199.text:
結果、私たちの文明を滅ぼした赤のほうき星こそが
白きほうき星の、変わり果てた姿なのだと気付いたの

localizations.en: What we found was that the Red Comet, the very force that destroyed our civilization, was the White Comet itself. Changed beyond recognition.

999008199.text:
――白きほうき星の多くが赤のほうき星へと変心し、
星々の生命を喰らう災厄となって星系を回遊していた

localizations.en: Most of the White Comets had transformed into Red Comets—calamities that devour all life as they roam the star system.

999008199.text:
白きほうき星の恵みは、ほぼ途絶えてしまった。
……これは私たちにとって、計算外の事態だったの

localizations.en: The blessings of the White Comet had all but vanished. ...This was something even we hadn't foreseen.

999008199.text:
私たちは、マナの代替になる資源を
青の星で見つけることもできなかった

localizations.en: We searched, but we couldn't find any resource on the Blue Star that could replace mana.

999008199.text:
それで、ランターナ王国はマナの枯渇に対応できず、
錬金術を見限ってしまったわ

localizations.en: And so Lantarna, unable to cope with the depletion, turned its back on alchemy.

999008199.text:
白きほうき星の恵みは復活しない……だけど、
人類の繁栄に錬金術は必要と、そう私たちは判断した

localizations.en: The White Comet's gifts would not return... but we still believed alchemy was essential to humanity's future.

999008199.text:
だから、黄金星に大量に眠っているマナを
供給しようと考えたの

localizations.en: So we looked to the vast reserves of mana sleeping here on the Golden Star as a solution.

999008199.text:
でも、私たちは歴史の表舞台に出るわけにはいかない。
それに安易に分け与えても良い影響が出るとは思えない

localizations.en: But we couldn't step into the light of history. And simply handing it over didn't seem like it would lead anywhere good.

999008199.text:
そこで考えたのよ。人類が自力でこの地にたどり着き、
マナの結晶を手に入れればいいと

localizations.en: So we devised another path. Humanity would reach this place on their own, and claim the mana crystals for themselves.

999008199.text: こうして生み出されたのが、「救世主計画」よ

localizations.en: That was how the Savior Plan was born.

999008199.text:
「救世主計画」は、一人の錬金術士により、
マナが豊富に眠る土地が発見されるというもの――

localizations.en: The Savior Plan called for a single alchemist to discover the land where mana lay dormant in abundance—

999008199.text:
だから果ての大陸の噂話を再度流したわ。それはかつて
流布した噂を媒介に、各地の宝島伝説と混じり合った

localizations.en: So we spread the rumors of World's End once more. The old stories we'd spread carried the rumor far and wide, where it mingled with local legends of treasure islands.

999008199.text:
一人の錬金術士が、その数少ない手掛かりから、
仲間たちと手を取り合って果ての大陸へたどり着き――

localizations.en: One alchemist, following a handful of clues, would join hands with companions and find their way to World's End—

999008199.text:
偉大なる錬金術士の名声と共に、
マナが行き渡り、失われた錬金術が再興される

localizations.en: And through the renown of that great alchemist, mana would flow back into the world, and alchemy would be restored.

999008199.text:
そして可能ならば、
マナに代わる資源を見つけ、人類の救世主となる――

localizations.en: And if possible, they would discover a resource to replace mana entirely—and become humanity's savior.

999008199.text:
その救世主役には、これからの世を生きる人類で
誰よりも錬金術に素養がある者が妥当だろうと考えたわ

localizations.en: For that role, we believed it should be someone with a greater natural gift for alchemy than anyone else alive in the age to come.
